method.grouping: Google records grouped by the mapped German Wikipedia article (fallback spreadsheet mapping)
method.score: T = 100*(0.65*G + 0.35*W); G = 0.6*p(growth)+0.4*p(interest) within Google cohort, best record per topic; W = 0.6*p(latest 7d views)+0.4*p(clipped log growth, +20 smoothing). Relative ranking within this dataset, not absolute demand.

limitations: Google values are normalised (0-100), not search counts; a rising '0' is a rounded small value.
Google period (18 Oct-18 Nov) and Wikipedia window differ.
The November rise is partly seasonal (Advent/Christmas baking), not necessarily a lasting trend.
Several search terms can share one broad Wikipedia article.
